card.name: Addiction in abuse and misuse warnings
card.fires_on: The word addiction (or the comma right after it) in boxed-warning wording about abuse, misuse and addiction, especially the heading "Abuse, Misuse, and Addiction" in benzodiazepine and opioid labels.

modes.label: Heading word
modes.description: The word Addiction ending the heading "Abuse, Misuse, and Addiction" in benzodiazepine labels.
modes.example: Abuse, Misuse, and<< Addiction>> The use of benzodiazepines

modes.label: Risk list
modes.description: Addiction or the comma after it in opioid risk lists such as addiction, abuse, and misuse.
modes.example: Use of TUXARIN ER in children also exposes them to the risks of addiction<<,>> abuse, and misuse
